description: Low-polish screen-recording style that feels like a creator discovering or testing a project in real time.
recommended_use: Single-product demos and walkthroughs. Best for showing a tool in action with a 'here's what this does' frame. For first-person POV of the builder discovering or reacting, use dev_pov_screen_capture instead. For Day-N progress series, use montage_buildlog.
reference_notes: Authentic beats polished. Keep it closer to a real creator demo than an ad.
Show the working result in the first two seconds.
Use real screen captures whenever possible.
Use voiceover and captions to explain only what the screen cannot show.
Avoid cinematic AI b-roll unless the project has no visual product surface.

composition_rules: The product or result must be visible immediately.
Use real UI, repo pages, terminal output, or deterministic proof cards for factual claims.
Keep overlays sparse; do not cover the main demo area.
Use phone-native vertical crops, not polished cinematic framing.

caption_treatment.style: bold white creator captions with black shadow

default_routes.hook: real screen recording of final result, or deterministic product proof card
default_routes.context: real repo/readme screenshot with annotation overlays
default_routes.payoff: real result screen with caption overlay
default_routes.b_roll: assembly zoom/pan over real capture; generated only if clearly non-literal

fallback_routes.demo_hero: proof_card plus screenshot; do not fake product UI
fallback_routes.low_motion_video: add deterministic zoom/cursor/highlight motion in assembly
